entries.source:
#GOLD#Instant Talents#LAST#
Some activated talents take no time to use, being activated with but a thought.
Unlike most talents, instant talents are never put on cooldown from being stunned, and may be usable when most other talents are not.
Specific information on each talent appears its tooltip.
entries.target:
#GOLD#瞬发技能#LAST#
有些主动技能使用时不消耗时间，一念之间即可发动。
和其他技能不同，瞬发技能不会因震慑而进入冷却状态，并且在大部分技能都不能使用的时候仍有可能使用。
有关技能的详细信息，请参阅技能的提示框。

entries.source: They are a sturdy race and are known for their masterwork, yet they are not well loved, having left other races to fend for themselves in past conflicts.
entries.target: 他们是一支强健的种族，以大师级手艺而闻名，但由于在过去的冲突中任由其他种族自生自灭，他们并不受人喜爱。

entries.source: Their affinity for nature and their reclusion have made them great protectors of the natural order, often opposing their Shaloren cousins.
entries.target: 他们对自然的亲近以及长期隐居的生活，使自然精灵成为自然秩序的守护者，也使他们经常与近亲永恒精灵对立。

entries.source: The known world has been at relative peace for over one hundred years, and people are prospering again.
entries.target: 已知世界已经保持了一百多年的相对和平，人们的生活再度富足起来。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall, hooded man stares at you*#WHITE#
Yes...yes...you look like a promising warrior indeed...
I have an offer, @playerdescriptor.race@.
You see...I am an agent for the Arena. I look for promising warriors that
can provide a good show for our audience. Perhaps you are strong enough to join.
All you need to do is beat three of my men in battle, and you shall be rewarded.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You consider the offer of the mysterious hooded man for a moment*
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个高大、头戴兜帽的男人注视着你*#WHITE#
是的……是的……你的确像是一名很有潜力的战士……
我有个提议，@playerdescriptor.race@。
你看……我是竞技场的招募员，专门寻找有潜力的战士，
为观众献上精彩表演。或许你足够强大，能够加入我们。
你只需在战斗中击败我的三名手下，就能获得奖励。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你对这个神秘兜帽人的提议思量了片刻*

entries.source:
The news has indeed reached me. I could scarce believe it, so long have we been at war with the Pride.
Now they are dead? At the hands of just one @playerdescriptor.race@? Truly I am amazed by your power.
While you were busy bringing an end to the orcs, we managed to discover some parts of the truth from a captive orc.
He talked about the shield protecting the High Peak. It seems to be controlled by "orbs of command" which the masters of the Prides had in their possession.
He also said the only way to enter the peak and de-activate the shield is through the "slime tunnels", located somewhere in one of the Prides, probably Grushnak.
entries.target:
我的确已经得到了消息，真令人难以置信，我们和兽人已经战斗得太久了。
他们现在都死了么？仅凭一个@playerdescriptor.race@的力量？你的力量真让我惊叹。
当你忙于解决那些兽人的时候，我们设法从那个兽人俘虏那里获得了一些线索。
他提起了有关巅峰保护罩的事。似乎那个护罩是受“指令水晶球”操控的，那些指令水晶球就在兽人各大部落首领的手中。
他还说想要进入巅峰并关闭护罩的唯一通道是“史莱姆通道”，位于某一个兽人部落内，有可能是格鲁希纳克的部落。

entries.source: I can indeed offer some martial training (talent category Technique/Combat-training) for a fee of 50 gold pieces; or the basic usage of bows and slings (Shoot talent) for 8 gold pieces.
entries.target: 我的确可以为你提供战斗训练（格斗/战斗训练系），你需要花费50金币，或者可以学习使用弓和投石索（射击技能），花费8金币。

entries.source: A large black cat, slender and muscular.
entries.target: 一只体型硕大、身形修长且肌肉发达的黑豹。

entries.source: This vile abomination is a relative of ghouls, and often leads packs of them. It smells foul, and its bite carries a rotting disease.
entries.target: 这个肮脏的生物是食尸鬼的近亲，经常带领着一群食尸鬼。它散发着令人作呕的气息，噬咬会传染腐烂疫病。

entries.source: A giant black-skinned humanoid covered in spikey scabrous deposits.  Its face is featureless; its eyesockets, empty and hollow.
entries.target: 一个黑皮肤的巨大人形生物，全身覆盖着尖刺状的粗糙结块。它的脸没有五官；眼窝空空荡荡。

entries.source: A large sluglike creature with the face of a man.  Shadows seem to be drawn to its massive form, and your light dims as it approaches.
entries.target: 一只长着人脸的巨型蛞蝓状生物。阴影似乎都被吸向它庞大的身躯，当它靠近时，你的光源会变得暗淡。

entries.source: This crimson shape drips ceaselessly, spattering the nearby ground. The droplets seem to continue moving of their own volition.
entries.target: 这个血红色的物体不停滴落液体，溅洒在附近的地面上。滴落的液滴似乎仍在自行移动。

entries.source: A massive, amorphous blob of green slime crawls on the ground towards you. Eyes drift through the viscous mass, scanning for potential prey.
entries.target: 一团巨大的、无定形的绿色粘液在地面上向你爬来。一只只眼睛在这团黏稠物质中游移，搜寻潜在的猎物。

entries.source:
A vaguely tentacled yet rapidly changing shape floats here.  With each breath you can feel reality twist, shatter, and break. 
Blue burns into red, green bursts into yellow, and the air crackles and hisses before exploding into a thousand fragments of sharp shapes and colors.
entries.target:
一团隐约带着触手、却在飞速变幻的形体漂浮在这里。每一次呼吸，你都能感到现实在扭曲、碎裂、崩坏。
蓝色烧成红色，绿色爆成黄色，空气噼啪嘶鸣，随后炸裂成千片尖锐的形状与色彩。

entries.source: maelstrom
entries.target: 大漩涡

entries.source: Dozens - hundreds maybe? - of blood-gorged worms, of varying shapes and sizes, making a writhing, ichor-soaked sea of tooth-lined maws and sickly green skin, ready to latch onto you and drink until they burst or your veins run dry.
entries.target: 几十条——也许几百条？——形状、大小各异的蠕虫吸饱了鲜血，汇成一片浸满脓液、不断翻腾的虫海，满是布满利齿的大口和病态的绿色皮肤。它们随时准备缠住你吸血，直到自己胀破，或你的血管被吸干。

entries.source:
A horror from the deepest pits of the earth. It looks like a huge pile of tentacles all trying to reach for you.
You can discern a huge round mouth covered in razor-sharp teeth.
entries.target:
这是来自地底最深处的恐魔。它看上去像一大堆触手，每一条都想要抓住你。
你能辨认出一张巨大的圆形嘴巴，里面布满了剃刀般锋利的牙齿。

entries.source: Time seems to warp and bend around this floating weapon.
entries.target: 时间似乎在这把漂浮的武器周围扭曲、弯折。

entries.source: A vile looking liquid flows from the teeth of this agile monster. It glides through the water towards you, spined fins jutting outwards.
entries.target: 这个敏捷怪物的齿间流淌着令人作呕的液体。它在水中向你滑游而来，带刺的鳍向外凸出。

entries.source: swarm hive
entries.target: 群生恐魔巢穴

entries.source: dredgling
entries.target: 小挖掘魔

entries.source: It looks like a hole in spacetime, but you get the impression it's somehow more than that.
entries.target: 它乍一看像是时空中的一道缝隙，但你隐约觉得它不只是这样。

entries.source: An elder being from a now-forgotten age, filled and fueled by its hate and rage toward all things living, it seeks to deprive all others of a prize it cannot have... life.
entries.target: 一个来自早已被遗忘的时代的古老存在，对一切生者的仇恨与怒火充斥并驱动着它；它试图剥夺其他一切存在所拥有、而它无法拥有的珍宝……生命。

entries.source: Manaworms are losgoroth which feed on the mana of arcane users. If they ever come in contact with a spellcaster, they latch on and start draining mana away.
entries.target: 法力蠕虫是以奥术使用者的法力值为食的洛斯格罗斯。如果它们近距离接触到施法者，就会缠上去，开始吸取对方的法力值。

entries.source:
This demon would look like a minotaur, if a minotaur had a fiery aura surrounding it and horns all over its body.
Oh, and it is twice as big, too.
entries.target:
这只恶魔长得像一只米诺陶，如果米诺陶周身环绕着炽焰光环、全身长满尖角的话。
哦，而且它还有两倍大。

entries.source: champion of Urh'Rok
entries.target: 乌鲁洛克的精英卫兵

entries.source: One of Urh'Rok's own champions. A thousand nightmares made flesh and screaming steel tower before you in the form of a massive, armored humanoid.
entries.target: 乌鲁洛克麾下的精英卫兵之一。一千个噩梦化作血肉与尖啸的钢铁，以庞大的装甲人形之姿耸立在你面前。

entries.source: This massive form, sheathed in dark flames, stands tall above a legion of lesser demons. In his hands he holds a massive blackened battleaxe, flames dancing around the blades.
entries.target: 这个庞大的身躯笼罩在黑暗之炎中，高高耸立于一支低阶恶魔军团之上。他手中握着一柄巨大的发黑战斧，火焰在斧刃周围舞动。

entries.source: A belligerent minotaur with a destructive magical arsenal, and armed with a hammer.
entries.target: 好战的米诺陶，手持巨锤，拥有毁灭性的魔法手段。

entries.source: A strange growth on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地牢地面上一片奇怪的菌丛。

entries.source: A strange grey growth on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地牢地面上一片奇怪的灰色菌丛。

entries.source: A strange brown growth on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地牢地面上一片奇怪的棕色菌丛。

entries.source: A strange luminescent growth on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地牢地面上一片奇怪的发光菌丛。

entries.source: Ureslak the Prismatic
entries.target: 棱彩的乌瑞斯拉克

entries.source: A fierce soldier-orc highly trained in the discipline of dragons.
entries.target: 一个彪悍的、受过严格龙战士训练的兽人士兵。

entries.source: An orc clad in massive armour. Magic seems to die down all around him.
entries.target: 一只穿着板甲的兽人，魔法似乎在它周围渐渐衰弱。

entries.source: An orc clad in massive armour, wielding a shield and a deadly axe.
entries.target: 一只身穿板甲的兽人，手持一面盾牌和一把致命的战斧。

entries.source: A morbidly obese orc with greasy pockmarked skin and oily long black hair.  He's clad in plate mail and carries a huge granite battleaxe that's nearly as large as he is.
entries.target: 一只肥胖过度的兽人，他有一头油乎乎的黑色长发，皮肤油腻且布满麻坑。他身穿板甲，手握一把几乎和他一样大的花岗岩双手斧。

entries.source: A not-so-strange growth on the dungeon floor.
entries.target: 地牢地面上一片不怎么奇怪的植物。

entries.source: It feels no pain.  It moves with fluidity and strength that would tear natural muscles apart.  It must be from a fresh corpse, since its bones, armor, and weapon are all in pristine condition.  And it's furious.
entries.target: 它感觉不到疼痛。它的动作流畅而有力，若是血肉之躯，肌肉早已不堪承受而撕裂。它一定来自一具新鲜的尸体，因为它的骨头、装甲和武器都完好如新。而且，它怒不可遏。

entries.source: storm drake hatchling
entries.target: 风暴龙幼仔

entries.source: storm drake
entries.target: 风暴龙

entries.source: A mature storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一条成年风暴龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

entries.source: An old and powerful storm drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一条年长且强大的风暴龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

entries.source: midge swarm
entries.target: 蠓群

entries.source: A swarm of midges; they want blood.
entries.target: 一群蠓，它们渴望鲜血。

entries.source: You have intruded on their ground, and they will defend it at all costs.
entries.target: 你已经闯入了它们的地盘，它们会不惜一切代价保卫这里。

entries.source: Time and space collapse in upon this erratically-moving time elemental.
entries.target: 时空在这只行动飘忽不定的时间元素周围不断塌陷。

entries.source: Stealthy tricksters that leave a wake of deadfalls and other hazards.  They really just make a mess of things.
entries.target: 善于潜行的诡计高手，所过之处遍布落石陷阱和其他危险机关。他们真的只会把一切弄得一团糟。

entries.source: Layers of rotting skin are peeling off of this rat. One of the eye sockets appears empty.
entries.target: 一层层腐烂的皮肤正从这只老鼠身上剥落，它的一只眼窝似乎是空的。

entries.source: An eerie haze surrounds this translucent rat.
entries.target: 诡异的薄雾环绕着这只半透明的老鼠。

entries.source: Frightening Squeak??
entries.target: 恐怖的吱吱声？？

entries.source: A foul wind chills your bones as this ghastly figure approaches.
entries.target: 当这个可怕的身影逼近时，一股污浊的阴风令你寒彻骨髓。

entries.source: A mature corrosive venom drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一条具有腐蚀性的成年毒龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

entries.source: An old and powerful corrosive venom drake, armed with deadly breath and nasty claws.
entries.target: 一条年长且强大的腐蚀性毒龙，拥有致命的吐息和锋利的爪子。

entries.source: It is a ghostly form with eyes that haunt you.
entries.target: 它呈幽灵形态，那双眼睛在你脑海中挥之不去。

entries.source: A huge creature of the element Earth. Able to merge with its element, it has four huge arms protruding from its enormous torso.
entries.target: 一只巨大的土元素生物。它能与自身元素融为一体，庞大的躯干上伸出四只巨大的手臂。

entries.source: Fragmented essence... maybe it'd be best if it stayed fragmented.
entries.target: 精华碎片……或许让它保持碎裂才是最好的。

entries.source: steel battleaxe
entries.target: 钢双手斧

entries.source: steel greatsword
entries.target: 钢大剑

entries.source: deep-steel trident
entries.target: 深钢三叉戟

entries.source: iron waraxe
entries.target: 铁战斧

entries.source: steel waraxe
entries.target: 钢战斧

entries.source: dwarven-steel waraxe
entries.target: 矮人钢战斧

entries.source: Tooth of the Mouth
entries.target: 大嘴怪之牙

entries.source: A huge tooth taken from the Mouth, in the Deep Bellow.
entries.target: 一颗取自深渊咆哮中大嘴怪的巨大牙齿。

entries.source: Arrows are used with bows to pierce your foes to death.
entries.target: 箭矢与弓配合使用，用来射穿敌人。

entries.source: Taint of Purging
entries.target: 污印：清除

entries.source:
Fire an arrow for %d%% weapon damage and call up to 2 wardens, depending on available space, that will each fire a single arrow before returning to their timelines.
		The wardens are out of phase with normal reality and deal %d%% less damage but shoot through friendly targets. All your arrows, including arrows from Shoot and other talents, now phase through friendly targets without causing them harm.
		
		Bow Threading talents will freely swap to your bow when activated if you have one in your secondary slot. You may use the Shoot talent in a similar manner.
entries.target:
发射一支灵矢造成 %d%% 武器伤害，并且根据可用空间，召唤最多两个守卫，各自发射一枚灵矢然后回到他们自己的时间线中。
		守卫处在现实位面之外，灵矢的伤害减少 %d%%， 但能够穿过友好目标。同时，你发射的所有来自射击或者其他技能的箭矢，都可以穿透友军并且不会造成伤害。

		激活螺旋灵弓技能可以自由切换到你的弓（必须装备在副武器栏位上）。此外，当你使用射击技能时也会触发这个效果。
